problem.title: Linear Search Using Recursion
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of integers and a target value, determine whether the target exists in the array using recursion. Return true if found; otherwise return false.
problem.input: Integer n Array nums Integer target
problem.output: true if the target exists, otherwise false.
